description:
Pilot the submarine in GCompris to demonstrate buoyancy principles. 

1. Launch GCompris and navigate to the Science/Discovery category (icon with test tubes/lightbulb).
2. Open the 'Submarine' activity.
3. Pilot the submarine to the ocean floor/target zone by filling the ballast tanks (intake valve).
4. When at the bottom/target, take a screenshot and save it to '~/Documents/submarine_depth.png'.
5. Pilot the submarine back to the surface by emptying the ballast tanks (release valve/pump).
6. When back at the surface, take a screenshot and save it to '~/Documents/submarine_surface.png'.
7. Create a text file '~/Documents/captains_log.txt' explaining the physics used (mentioning keywords like 'ballast', 'density', 'sink', or 'rise').
